paragraph: Conversely, if the least period is4, antipodal pairing gives n_2=-n_0 and h_2=h_0. Apply (5) to (n_0,n_1) and (n_1,n_2). The cosine of the normal difference and the cosine of the normal sum both change sign, while the left side in each identity is d h_0 h_1. Adding the two identities gives 2d h_0 h_1=0. Since the support numbers are positive, d=0. Thus the four-period case and d=0 coincide.
check: n2=-n0 makes both the dot-product and axis-difference bilinear terms negate; h2=h0 makes both left sides d*h0*h1; adding gives 2*d*h0*h1=0. Positive supports imply d=0.
